4. Field Test Plan
Planned document. Field deployment scope and test activities will evolve as site readiness and product milestones progress. Nothing here is a fixed delivery schedule.

UBR Field Test Plan — Proddatur

Real-world validation of UBR P2MP in a live customer environment — throughput, GPS, link health, and NMS interop on an always-accessible site with power backup.

1:8 PTMP (initial) BTS Site — Proddatur Power backup 24×7 site access
Deployment phases
Initial deployment Current plan

Phase 1: One BTS at Proddatur serving eight CPE endpoints across the mapped coverage area. Raspberry Pi at each CPE runs throughput scripts and captures GPS/azimuth data for NMS validation.

Site map — Proddatur coverage

BTS Site — Proddatur serves as the central hub. Red lines indicate planned wireless links to remote subscriber locations (e.g. BSNL Office, Shiva Balaji Residency, IIFL Gold Loan area). Each endpoint becomes a CPE install point for field throughput and GPS characterisation in real urban RF conditions.

Site readiness

Always accessible

BTS hub and remote CPE sites reachable for scheduled and ad-hoc test runs without access restrictions.

Power backup

UPS / backup power at the hub site so testing can continue through mains outages.

NMS connected

Devices onboarded to NMS for live inventory, alarms, KPIs, and remote troubleshooting during field runs.

Field test activities (planned)

Throughput

Multi-client iPerf / TRex runs per CPE — uplink & downlink at distance

GPS & azimuth

Lat/long, elevation, compass — birth certificate & NMS map accuracy

Link health

RSSI, SNR, MCS, retransmits — sustained monitoring over days/weeks

Alarms & events

Real-time fault injection — link loss, device reboot, NMS alarm path

QinQ / VLAN

Double-tagged traffic through BTS fronthaul — customer VLAN scenarios

Long-run soak

24 h+ stability — uptime, throughput drift, GPS relocation tolerance

ATPC / DCS

Adaptive power & channel selection under varying RF conditions

Sign-off evidence

Kiwi TCMS results, logs, PCAP, NMS exports for customer review

UBR Automation TestBed · Field test plan · Proddatur · Evolves with deployment progress

5. NMS Manual
Planned document. Validation scope and test cases will change as NMS development progresses. Nothing here is a fixed delivery schedule.

UBR NMS — Manual Testing Plan

Human-in-the-loop validation of the Network Management System against Requirements v1.4 — GUI workflows, device interop, and lab hardware on live BTS/CPE/IDU.

Requirements v1.4 72 REQ IDs Live lab hardware Human validation
What we validate manually

Discovery

CPE via NMS connect API · BTS via NMS server IP — spot-check fields & onboarding

Topology

Map view, GPS search, device icons, link health & event history

Inventory

BTS/CPE fields, birth certificate, tags, search & CSV/XLS export

Configuration

Per-device settings, templates, bulk updates & scheduled windows

Alarms & Events

Real-time raise/clear, thresholds, alarm views & history export

Core manual validation flow
End-to-end NMS validation on lab hardware
1
Auto-discovery
  • CPE: call NMS connect API — device appears in NMS
  • BTS: set NMS server IP on device — hub appears in NMS
2
Inventory check
  • Verify fields, birth certificate & topology placement
  • Search, tag & export CSV/XLS for evidence
3
Config apply
  • Apply template or per-device config from NMS GUI
  • Confirm job completes & inventory reflects change
4
Device verify
  • SSH to BTS/CPE — confirm UCI & runtime state
  • Cross-check NMS display vs device ground truth
5
Fault & alarm
  • Induce link or device fault in lab
  • Confirm alarm raise/clear in NMS in real time
  • Export alarm history for sign-off evidence
